parts.name: Tow Tractor AGV
parts.description: Tow-tractor style AGV visual model for factory layout. It is a static display part with no drive behavior or PLC tags.

parts.name: CNC Lathe
parts.description: Static CNC lathe teaching model for scene layout. It has no G-code interpreter, machining simulation, spindle motion, tool changing, or PLC behavior.

parts.name: Compact STS Crane
parts.description: Compact ship-to-shore container crane model for scene layout. The trolley and spreader are visual subassemblies only; the model has no articulated motion or PLC behavior.

parts.name: Lift AMR
parts.description: Low-profile lift AMR visual model for factory layout. It is a static display part with no lift animation, drive behavior, or PLC tags.

parts.name: Three-Floor Elevator
parts.description: Three-level elevator teaching model with a moving cabin, articulated landing and car doors, floor call buttons, and PLC tags for floor requests, motion, doors, and faults. The included scene and IEC Structured Text program demonstrate the built-in OIP simulation only; no external PLC is connected.
